company_info.full_name: China National Cereals, Oils and Foodstuffs Corporation (COFCO)
company_info.description: China's largest food processing company and a major global agribusiness player. Owner of Fortune (福临门) brand.

analysis.method: Supplier ESG Monitoring + Satellite Verification of Key Suppliers
analysis.result: Strong progress on traceability but exposed to high-risk suppliers

evidence.conclusion: COFCO itself has minimal direct land use. Main environmental risk comes from upstream palm oil suppliers. Currently 68% of palm oil volume is traceable to mill level, with target of 100% by end of 2025.

data_source.primary: Supplier self-reporting + GreenLink satellite monitoring + RSPO data
data_source.frequency: Quarterly supplier reviews + real-time alerts on high-risk suppliers
data_source.coverage: Key sourcing regions in Malaysia and Indonesia

compliance.eudr: ⚠️ In progress - 68% traceable to mill, working toward full EUDR compliance by Dec 2025
compliance.rspo: ✅ Mass Balance + Segregated certified volumes increasing yearly
compliance.ndpe: ✅ No Deforestation, No Peat, No Exploitation (NDPE) policy in place since 2020

metrics.supplier_esg_audited: 89% of Tier-1 suppliers audited in last 24 months

key_events.event: COFCO published its first Palm Oil Traceability Report with supplier list
key_events.impact: Positive transparency move. However, report revealed continued sourcing from several high-risk suppliers including FGV.
key_events.severity: Medium (Transparency positive, but risk exposure remains)

key_events.event: COFCO announced plan to suspend sourcing from suppliers that fail to meet EUDR requirements by Q3 2025
key_events.impact: Strong signal to upstream suppliers. Puts pressure on companies like FGV to accelerate remediation.

key_events.event: GreenLink flagged FGV as high social risk supplier to COFCO procurement team
key_events.impact: Enabled COFCO to initiate enhanced due diligence on FGV volumes and begin developing alternative low-risk supplier channels (including IOI).

traditional_rating.description: Traditional ratings reflect moderate risk mainly due to supply chain exposure in palm oil and other commodities. Improving with better traceability efforts.

root_causes: Heavy reliance on Malaysian and Indonesian palm oil supply chains with known labor and deforestation issues
Complex multi-tier supply chain making full traceability challenging
Historical lack of visibility into upstream plantation-level practices

metrics.grievance_cases: 7 cases received in 2023, all under investigation or resolved

suppliers.name: FGV Holdings Berhad
suppliers.risk_status: High Risk (75) - Social issues (CBP ban ongoing)

midstream.name: COFCO Food Processing Division
midstream.role: Major edible oil refiner and brand owner (Fortune / 福临门)
products: Golden Dragon Fish (金龙鱼) blended oils
midstream.exposure: Significant exposure to upstream palm oil ESG risks
midstream.annual_procurement: ~850,000 tons palm oil + other vegetable oils
midstream.dependency: High dependency on imported palm oil from Southeast Asia

markets: Export to Southeast Asia and Middle East

regulations.eu: High compliance pressure as COFCO exports some products to EU and supplies EU brands indirectly
regulations.us: Moderate risk - some volumes may enter US through third parties
regulations.china: Growing consumer and regulatory focus on sustainable food supply chains

market_impact.eu: High Risk - Must achieve full EUDR compliance by Dec 2025 or face market access issues
market_impact.us: Medium Risk - Indirect exposure through supply chain partners
market_impact.china: Low-Medium Risk - Domestic focus but international reputation matters for premium segment

impact_alert.message:
⚠️ SUPPLY CHAIN RISK ALERT FOR COFCO

Your upstream supplier FGV remains under active U.S. CBP import ban due to forced labor allegations. Although FGV submitted a remediation petition in June 2024, the ban is still in effect.

Current situation:
• 18% of your palm oil volume comes from FGV (High Social Risk)
• This creates potential EUDR compliance risk for EU-bound products
• Brand reputation risk for Fortune (福临门) in premium segment

Recommended immediate actions:
1. Accelerate volume reduction from FGV to below 8% by Q4 2025
2. Increase sourcing from low-risk suppliers (IOI, verified Sime Darby)
3. Require all Tier-1 suppliers to provide geolocation data for EUDR
4. Use GreenLink platform for continuous monitoring of high-risk suppliers

risk_scenarios.impact: Unable to export or supply EU brands after Dec 2025. Estimated revenue loss of 15-20% in affected categories. Major brand damage.
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Immediately prioritize full traceability program and reduce high-risk supplier volumes aggressively.

risk_scenarios.impact: Ongoing reputational and compliance risk. Potential customer complaints or loss of international contracts.
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Implement clear supplier exit strategy for FGV while maintaining supply security.

risk_scenarios.impact: Successfully reduce high-risk volumes and achieve 95%+ EUDR traceability by late 2025. Become preferred supplier for international brands.
risk_scenarios.mitigation: Continue current trajectory and use GreenLink for real-time supplier risk monitoring.
